title: Recovering the Euclidean Geometry of High-Dimensional Data Under Heterogeneous Noise
abstract: arXiv:2507.18520v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pairwise Euclidean distances provide a simple geometric representation of high-dimensional data and underlie many data analysis methods, including clustering, visualization, and manifold learning. However, in real-world applications, these distances can be severely corrupted by heterogeneous noise, where different data points are subject to different, and potentially large, noise levels. Such noise distorts the distances inhomogeneously, leading to a misrepresentation of the underlying data geometry. In this work, we ask whether the underlying clean Euclidean geometry can nevertheless be recovered from the corrupted pairwise distances. We answer this question affirmatively, showing that, perhaps surprisingly, such recovery is possible across a broad class of high-dimensional settings with underlying low-dimensional geometry, even when the noise magnitudes vary substantially across observations. We develop a principled approach

translated_title: 在异构噪声下恢复高维数据的欧几里得几何结构
translated_abstract: 成对欧几里得距离为高维数据提供了一种简单的几何表示，是包括聚类、可视化和流形学习在内的许多数据分析方法的基础。然而，在现实应用中，这些距离可能受到异构噪声的严重破坏，即不同的数据点会受到不同且可能很大的噪声水平影响。这种噪声会不均匀地扭曲距离，导致对底层数据几何结构的错误表示。在这项工作中，我们探讨是否仍然能够从被破坏的成对距离中恢复出底层的干净欧几里得几何结构。我们对这个问题给出了肯定的回答，表明——也许令人惊讶的是——即使噪声幅度在不同观测之间变化很大，这种恢复在广泛的具有底层低维几何结构的高维场景中也是可能的。我们开发了一种有原则的方法……
tldr: 本文证明了对于具有底层低维几何结构的高维数据，即使在异构噪声严重且不均匀地破坏成对欧几里得距离的情况下，仍然可以恢复出其底层干净的欧几里得几何结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the clean underlying Euclidean geometry of high-dimensional data with low-dimensional structure can be recovered from pairwise distances severely corrupted by heterogeneous noise, even when noise magnitudes vary substantially across observations.
